arguments.query: SELECT COUNT(*) as booking_count, SUM(CASE WHEN status='confirmed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as confirmed FROM bookings;

SELECT b.booking_id, b.status, COUNT(c.charge_id) as charge_count, COUNT(h.hold_id) as hold_count FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN charges c ON b.booking_id=c.booking_id LEFT JOIN holds h ON b.booking_id=h.booking_id GROUP BY b.booking_id;
SELECT name, sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table';

SELECT b.booking_id, b.status, COUNT(DISTINCT c.charge_id) as charge_count, CASE WHEN h.booking_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as has_hold FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN charges c ON b.booking_id=c.booking_id LEFT JOIN holds h ON b.booking_id=h.booking_id GROUP BY b.booking_id, h.booking_id ORDER BY b.booking_id;
SELECT COUNT(*) as pending_count FROM provider_ledger WHERE state = 'pending';
SELECT state, COUNT(*) as count FROM charges GROUP BY state;
